question: ISRO launched the Chandrayaan-1 spacecraft in _______. It was uniquely equipped to confirm the presence of solid ice on the moon.
solution:
The correct answer is __**2008.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• **ISRO launched the Chandrayaan-1 spacecraft in 2008. **
 
• India's first mission to the moon
 
• It was uniquely equipped to confirm the presence of solid ice on the moon.
 
• Findings indicate the presence of hematite at the lunar poles.
